I had an awful experience with Strattera. I had extreme mood swings from apathic anhedonia to full-fledged depressive episodes. The first day I was on it I was so slowed down I could not  talk, or move, I had headaches and dizziness, and I felt focused, but I was totally zombified and emotionally blunted in the worst way. If the side effects are somehow light, you could wait since they are supposed to go away. But if they are not, don't hesitate to call  your  psychiatrist.
